questions.stem: A 56-year-old woman is brought up because of progressive memory loss, weakness, diarrhea without nausea or vomiting, and several falls over the past 6 months. She was treated for tuberculosis 10 years ago. She drinks a pint of vodka daily. Examination shows glossitis and a hyperpigmented rash on her face and arms. On mental status examination, Short-term memory is impaired; she can recall 0 out of 5 objects after 10 minutes. Which deficiencies is most likely present in this patient?
